history.speaker: A
history.text: Buenas, ¿qué le pongo? Los tomates están a 2 euros el kilo.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Are the peaches ripe?

history.speaker: A
history.text: Sí, muy maduros. Los melocotones a 3 euros el kilo.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Great, I'll take some peaches.

text: Can I get a kilo and a half of the peachs and two kilos tomatos pls
meaning: The customer wants 1.5 kg of peaches and 2 kg of tomatoes.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Hi, can you take me to the train station?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Claro, ¿a la estación de Atocha?

history.speaker: A
history.text: Yes. How long will it take and how much?

text: Unos veinte minutos si no hay trafico, mas o menos 18 euros, y aceptamos tarjeta tambien
meaning: The taxi driver says it takes about 20 minutes without traffic, costs about 18 euros, and card is accepted.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Le recomiendo la paella de marisco o el pollo al ajillo.

history.speaker: B
history.text: I have a severe shellfish allergy.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Entonces el pollo. Pero la salsa lleva un caldo de gambas.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Oh no. Can the kitchen make the chicken without the sauce?

history.speaker: A
history.text: Sí, puedo pedirlo a la plancha, sin salsa.

text: Perfect, but please make sure it doesn't even touch the same pan as it
meaning: The diner wants grilled chicken that does not touch the pan used for the shrimp-broth sauce, because of a shellfish allergy.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Hi! First time in Mexico City?

history.speaker: B
history.text: No, yo soy de aquí. ¿Y tú?

history.speaker: A
history.text: First time here. Any tips for the weekend?

text: Ve a Xochimilco el sábado, está bien chido, pero no vayas con mucha lana, hay mucho chavo que te bolsea
meaning: The local suggests visiting Xochimilco on Saturday, says it is really cool, and warns not to carry much money because some young people pickpocket.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Aquí tiene su ibuprofeno de 400 miligramos.

history.speaker: B
history.text: How many should I take a day?

history.speaker: A
history.text: Una pastilla cada ocho horas, máximo tres al día, con comida.

history.speaker: B
history.text: And my son is 9. Can he take it too?

history.speaker: A
history.text: No, para él mejor un jarabe infantil.

text: Ok so for him the syrup, how many mill liters and how often? He waits about 30 kilos
meaning: The parent asks how many milliliters of children's syrup to give their 9-year-old son and how often, noting he weighs about 30 kg.

history.speaker: B
history.text: こんにちは。どちらまで行きますか？

history.speaker: A
history.text: Shinagawa Station, please.

history.speaker: B
history.text: 品川駅ですね。何口がいいですか？

history.speaker: A
history.text: Sorry, which exit is closer to the Prince Hotel?

history.speaker: B
history.text: プリンスホテルなら高輪口が近いですよ。

text: ok then can you drop me at the takanawa exti, not the nroth one
meaning: The passenger asks the driver to drop them at the Takanawa exit of Shinagawa Station, not the north exit.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Hi, I have a bad cold and a sore throat.

history.speaker: B
history.text: こちらの風邪薬はいかがですか。眠くなりにくいタイプです。

history.speaker: A
history.text: Okay. How many should I take?

history.speaker: B
history.text: 大人の方ですね。少々お待ちください。

text: 一日二回、職後に一錠ずつ飲んでください。
meaning: The pharmacist says to take one tablet twice a day after meals; 職後 is an IME conversion error for 食後.

history.speaker: A
history.text: My son is allergic to peanuts.

history.speaker: B
history.text: かしこまりました。カレーとサラダ、どちらになさいますか？

history.speaker: A
history.text: Does the curry have them?

history.speaker: B
history.text: はい、カレーには少し入っています。

text: if it does can you make his without them? mine is fine as is
meaning: The parent asks the restaurant to make the son's curry without peanuts and says their own curry can stay as is.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How much are these peaches?

history.speaker: B
history.text: 一個450円です。今朝届いたばかりですよ。

history.speaker: A
history.text: Hmm, a bit expensive. What if I buy two?

text: マジっすか、じゃあ2個で800円にしとくわ！
meaning: The vendor casually agrees to sell two peaches for 800 yen total instead of 900 yen.

history.speaker: B
history.text: おはようございます。何かお困りですか？

history.speaker: A
history.text: What time is checkout?

history.speaker: B
history.text: チェックアウトは11時です。

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is a later checkout possible?

history.speaker: B
history.text: 空き状況によっては可能です。何時ごろご希望ですか？

text: Could we do 1pm? Our fight leaves at 6 so we dont need to rush
meaning: The guest asks for a 1pm late checkout because their flight leaves at 6; 'fight' is an autocorrect error for 'flight'.

history.speaker: A
history.text: My son has a fever. Is this syrup okay for a 6-year-old?

history.speaker: B
history.text: បាទ ថ្នាំនេះក្មេងប្រើបាន។ ផឹក ៥ មីលីលីត្រ ម្ដង។

history.speaker: A
history.text: And my daughter is 2. Can she take it too?

history.speaker: B
history.text: កុំឲ្យនាងផឹកថ្នាំនេះ។ នាងតូចពេក។

text: ok so he gets it 3 times a day but she doesnt, right?
meaning: The parent confirms that the 6-year-old son takes the syrup three times a day and the 2-year-old daughter does not take it.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How much to Wat Phnom?

history.speaker: B
history.text: ប្រាំមួយពាន់រៀល។

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you wait 10 minutes while I take photos?

text: បាន តែរងចាំ បន្ថែម ២ពាន់រៀល
meaning: The taxi driver agrees to wait the 10 minutes for an extra 2,000 riel on top of the 6,000 riel fare.

history.speaker: A
history.text: តើលោកចង់ញ៉ាំអ្វី?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Fried rice please. I'm allergic to peanuts.

history.speaker: A
history.text: សម្លនេះមានសណ្ដែកដី។ បាយឆាគ្មានទេ។

text: great, and pls no oyster sause, im alergic to shelfish too
meaning: The customer orders the peanut-free fried rice and asks for no oyster sauce because they are also allergic to shellfish.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How much for this scarf?

history.speaker: B
history.text: ក្រមានេះ ប្រាំដុល្លារ។

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you do 4 dollars for it?

text: អូខេ បង ៤ដុល្លាក៏បាន ព្រោះបងឡូយ 😄
meaning: The market seller jokingly accepts $4 for the krama scarf, down from $5, saying it is because the customer is cool.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Hi, I booked a room for three nights.

history.speaker: B
history.text: សូមបង្ហាញលិខិតឆ្លងដែន។ បន្ទប់លេខ ៣១២។

history.speaker: A
history.text: Thanks. Where is the nearest pharmacy?

history.speaker: B
history.text: ដើរត្រង់ ហើយបត់ឆ្វេងនៅភ្លើងស្តុប។

text: Thanks! Can I get late checkout on Sunday at 1 pm? We have a late fight
meaning: The hotel guest in room 312 asks to check out late, at 1 pm on Sunday, because they have a late flight.

history.speaker: A
history.text: How much are these pears?

history.speaker: B
history.text: 한 개에 팔천 원이에요.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you give me a discount if I buy two?

text: 두 개 하면 만오쳔원에 드릴게여
meaning: The vendor offers two pears for 15,000 won instead of 16,000 won.

history.speaker: A
history.text: 어디로 모실까요?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Gangnam Station, exit 11 please.

history.speaker: A
history.text: 네, 한 25분 정도 걸려요.

text: Could we stop at a gas station first? I really need the bathtub
meaning: The passenger asks the driver to stop at a gas station first because they need to use the bathroom.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I'm allergic to sesame. Does the bibimbap or the japchae have it?

history.speaker: B
history.text: 비빔밥에는 참기름이 들어가요.

history.speaker: A
history.text: And the other one?

text: 그건 안 들어가요, 대신 새우가 쪼금 있어요
meaning: The server says the japchae has no sesame but contains a small amount of shrimp.

history.speaker: A
history.text: 이 약은 식후에 드세요.

history.speaker: B
history.text: How many each time?

history.speaker: A
history.text: 한 번에 두 알이요. 6시간 간격으로요.

text: So 2 pils every 6 hrs, max 4 tims a day?
meaning: The customer confirms taking two pills every six hours, at most four times a day.

history.speaker: A
history.text: 프런트입니다. 무엇을 도와드릴까요?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Hi, I'm in room 1207.

history.speaker: A
history.text: 네, 손님. 말씀하세요.

text: The AC's totally busted, can someone come up asap?
meaning: The guest in room 1207 says the air conditioner is broken and asks for someone to come fix it as soon as possible.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Hi, how much are the mangoes?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Xoài cát Hòa Lộc đó chị, ngọt lắm.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is it cheaper if I buy more than one kilo?

text: ba chuc nghin mot ky, chi lay hai ky thi em bot cho nam nghin
meaning: The vendor says the mangoes are 30,000 dong per kilo, and if the customer buys two kilos she will take 5,000 dong off.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you take me to Ben Thanh Market?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Dạ được, khoảng hai mươi phút nếu không kẹt xe.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Do you take cards?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Dạ không, em chỉ nhận tiền mặt thôi.

text: ok pls stop at the gas staton befor the brige, i need to get cash
meaning: The passenger asks the driver to stop at the gas station before the bridge so the passenger can withdraw cash.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I'm allergic to shellfish. Which dishes are safe?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Bún riêu có cua, còn phở bò thì không có hải sản.

history.speaker: A
history.text: And the spring rolls?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Chả giò có tôm ạ.

text: ok so not those, I'll take the other one but no herbs pls
meaning: The customer will not order the crab noodle soup or the shrimp spring rolls and orders the beef pho without herbs.

history.speaker: A
history.text: I have a bad headache and a fever.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Anh uống thuốc này, mỗi lần hai viên, cách sáu tiếng một lần.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is there a limit per day?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Một ngày không quá tám viên nhé.

text: Got it, 2 pills every sex hours and no more than ate a day, right?
meaning: The customer confirms the dose: two tablets every six hours, with a maximum of eight tablets per day.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Good evening, how can I help you?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Em ở phòng 412, ngay cạnh thang máy.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is there a problem with the room?

text: Ồn xỉu luôn á, đổi giúp em phòng tầng cao hơn được hong?
meaning: The guest in room 412 says the room is extremely noisy and asks the receptionist to move them to a room on a higher floor.
